name: Discord
one_liner: Discord REST (v10) + Gateway APIs for bots and OAuth2 apps; OpenAPI 3.1 preview spec published by Discord.
auth_notes: Bot token from Developer Portal ('Authorization: Bot TOKEN'); OAuth2 user bearer tokens; incoming webhook URLs need no auth.
access_notes: Bot creation is self-serve. Privileged gateway intents are toggled in portal; apps in 100+ guilds require verification and intent approval.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve bot token and documented REST/Gateway API with an OpenAPI preview spec. Verification only matters at 100+ guilds or privileged intents at scale.

needs_human_reason: No official Discord MCP found; spec endpoint count not computed (fetch truncated).

auth.quote: For verified apps (required for apps in 100+ guilds), the intent must also be approved after the verification process

api_surface.quote: This repository contains the public preview of the OpenAPI 3.1 specification for Discord's API.
rate limits should not be hard coded into your app

disputes.why: Bot tokens self-serve; no paid plan stated for API use.
Official OpenAPI 3.1 preview spec exists in Discord GitHub org.
Spec and docs cover dozens of resources; first pass itself estimated 73 tools.
OAuth2 user tokens are bearer tokens.
OAuth2 scopes are granular per Discord docs.
